texts.index: Your database for all information around Ships and Stations in Star Citizen.
texts.indexQuote:
“Strap into one of dozens of ships and embark on a life within the Star Citizen universe.
Unbound by profession or skill sets, you choose the path of your own life.”

support.info: Not spending? Upvote us on Spectrum to help more people find FleetYards.

installApp.eventSignup: Install FleetYards as an app to get back to your events in one tap.
installApp.iosIntro: On iPhone and iPad, apps like FleetYards are installed from the share sheet:
installApp.iosShare: Tap the Share button in the browser toolbar.
installApp.iosAdd: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. You may have to scroll down to find it.
installApp.iosConfirm: Tap “Add”. FleetYards now opens from your Home Screen like any other app.

supportHint.hangarSync: Background syncs are the biggest item on our hosting bill. FleetYards runs on donations — if you'd like to chip in, every bit helps.
supportHint.vehicleAdded: FleetYards is free and ad-free, and runs entirely on donations. If it's useful to you, a small contribution helps keep it that way.
supportHint.fleetCreated: Fleets are one of our most resource-heavy features. FleetYards stays free and ad-free thanks to donations — consider chipping in.
supportHint.loginMilestone: You've been around for a while — thank you. FleetYards runs on donations; if you'd like to help cover the bill, here's how.
supportHint.visitMilestone: FleetYards is community-funded — no ads, no paywalls. If you find it useful, a small donation goes a long way.

ships.info: To start select at least two and not more than eight Ships you want to compare.

fleets.leaveInfo: You can not leave the Fleet.
fleets.directory: Verified fleets that chose to be found. Every fleet here has proved it runs its RSI organisation.

destroyedFleets.purgedWarning: Restoring a purged fleet is best-effort. Roles, images, invite links and fleet vehicles are not restored.

viewsFolder.hint: Drop a folder of views named top.png, side.png, front.png and angled.png. Suffix _colored for the painted set, prefix extended_ for the extended one and landed_ for the landed one. A flight_ prefix, or none at all, goes to the default set. holo.gltf comes along too, with the same prefixes.

welcome.title: Welcome to your hangar
welcome.text: Your hangar keeps track of every ship you own. This short tour shows where everything is — you can replay it from the menu at any time.

add.title: Add ships
add.text: Pick one or more ships and how many of each. On any ship's page or card, the bookmark icon adds it to your hangar or wishlist too.

sync.title: Sync from RSI
sync.text: Already pledged? With the FleetYards browser extension installed, sync your RSI hangar instead of adding ships by hand — and again whenever your pledges change.

groups.title: Groups
groups.text: Sort your ships into groups of your own with + and the pen. Click a group to filter by it, hover it to highlight its ships.

vehicle.title: Each ship's menu
vehicle.text: Edit a ship from here: name it, pick its paint, make it your flagship, set its visibility, manage loadouts or move it to your wishlist.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.text: Ships you want but don't own yet go on your wishlist, with optional sale notifications.

fleetchart.title: Fleetchart
fleetchart.text: Line your ships up side by side to scale, and save the chart as an image.

stats.title: Stats
stats.text: Roles, manufacturers, sizes and what you have spent, with a CSV export.

share.title: Share your hangar
share.text: Your public hangar is on. Share its link — you decide which ships and groups appear there.

menu.title: More
menu.text: Import and export your hangar, buy-backs and your import history — and this tour, whenever you want it again.

notified.headline: Get notified about new Ships and Sales
notified.text: Get notified once a new Ship is released on robertsspaceindustries.com and never miss a Sale. You can also enable Sale Notifications for Ships in your Hangar.

manage.headline: Manage your Hangar
manage.text: Add Ships to your Hangar, name your Ships, mark them as wanted or get notified if a Ship gets on Sale. Decide which Ship you want to show on your Public Hangar. Get further Insights into your Hangar: Which Roles can your Ships fulfil? How many Ships are Flight Ready? What is your main Manufacturer? How much money did you spend?

fleetchart.headline: Fleetchart and Public Hangar
fleetchart.text: View your Ships as a scaled topview Fleetchart and export it as an image. Get a Public Hangar page which you can share with others, you decide what Ships will be visible on your Public Hangar.

notified.headline: Analyze
notified.text: View stats of your Fleet - analyze and optimize for roles, cargo capacity etc.

overview.headline: Overview & Manage
overview.text: Invite your Org Mates and get a filterable and searchable list of all public Ships.

fleetchart.headline: Fleetchart
fleetchart.text: View your Fleet as a scaled topview Fleetchart and export it as an image.

privacy.text:
The use of our site is usually possible without providing any personal data. The collecting of personal data (eg email address) on our sites will be, as far as possible, on a voluntary basis. No personal data will be passed on to third parties without your explicit consent.
We point out that data transmission over the Internet (eg when communicating by email) can have security gaps. A complete protection of data against access by third parties is not possible.
privacy.p1: Below you can read about what Information we are using to provide you the services on %{app}. For most parts this only concerns registered Users but please read further to get a full overview.

p2.headline: What Information do we use?
p2.text: Depending on if you are a registered User or only using %{app} as a Guest we use more or less Information from you.

p3.headline: As a Guest
p3.text: As a Guest on %{app} we collect the following data:

analytics.headline: Usage analytics
analytics.basis: %{app} counts page views to understand which parts of the site are actually used. This runs on our legitimate interest in operating and improving the site, not on consent: the data is collected first-party only, IP addresses are anonymised before they are stored, no cookies or other identifiers are placed on your device, and nothing is shared with advertising networks.
analytics.retention: Individual visits and page views are deleted after one month. Only aggregated counts, which cannot be traced back to a person, are kept beyond that. Deleting your account also deletes the visits recorded for it.

objection.headline: How to object
objection.text: You can object to usage analytics at any time, and we will stop recording it rather than merely hiding it.
objection.user: Your account setting under Settings is applied to every device you sign in on.
objection.guest: Without an account you can object here. We also honour the Global Privacy Control signal if your browser sends one.

privacy.tracking: When this is enabled we count the pages you visit to see which parts of the site are used. IP addresses are anonymised, nothing is stored on your device, and individual visits are deleted after one month. Turning it off stops the recording entirely.
privacy.onlineStatus: When this is enabled, the members of your fleets and your friends see a dot next to your name while you have FleetYards open. Turning it off hides it from them — nothing else changes, and your last activity is still shown.

notifications.hint: Pick how each event reaches you. App notifications are collected in your notification center, mail goes to your account's address.

push.title: Push notifications
push.intro: Get notifications on this device even while FleetYards is closed. Which ones arrive as push is set in the Push column below.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. On an iPhone or iPad, add FleetYards to your Home Screen and open it from there.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for FleetYards in this browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then reload this page.
push.on: Push notifications are on for this device.
push.off: Push notifications are off for this device.
push.failed: Push notifications could not be checked for this device. Reload the page to try again.

oauthAuthorize.requestingAccess: %{clientName} is requesting access to your account.
oauthAuthorize.scopesIntro: This application will be able to:

buybacks.intro: The pledges you melted on RSI and could buy back, as of your last sync. Syncing reads your RSI buy-back list through the Fleetyards Sync Extension.

buybackSync.info: This reads every page of your RSI buy-back list and replaces the buy-back pledges stored on Fleetyards with it. Your hangar is not touched. Long lists take a few minutes.
buybackSync.unsupported: Your Fleetyards Sync Extension cannot read buy-back pledges yet. Update it to sync them.
buybackSync.detailsInfo: The first sync also reads the price and insurance of every pledge, one RSI page each, which can take a quarter of an hour for a long list. Later syncs only read the new ones.
buybackSync.detailsUnsupported: Update your Fleetyards Sync Extension to read prices and insurance as well.
buybackSync.detailsIncomplete: Some prices could not be read from RSI. The next sync tries them again.

syncExtension.gettingStarted: To sync your RSI Hangar with Fleetyards you first need to install the Fleetyards Sync Extension for Firefox or Chromium based Browsers.
syncExtension.info:
We will try to match the ships from your RSI Hangar with your existing ships in your Fleetyards Hangar by using the name and the pledge-id. Ships from the RSI Hangar without a match will be added to your Fleetyards Hangar.

Do you want to continue?
syncExtension.alreadyRunning: A Hangar Sync is already in progress. Please wait for it to finish.

texts.setEmail: To set a password, enable two-factor authentication, or receive email notifications, you need to add an email address to your account. You will receive a confirmation email to verify the address.

oauthApplications.pendingReview: This application has been registered and is waiting to be reviewed. It cannot request access until it is approved.
oauthApplications.rejected: This application was refused and cannot request access. Correcting what the reason names puts it back in the queue.
oauthApplications.returnedToReview: Changing the redirect URI or the scopes returns an approved application to review.
